note: Official Bandai list. Banned cards can't be in a deck at all, in any art. A banned pair means those two cards can't be in the same deck.

banned.why: Green Mihawk was over a fifth of all tournament decks. Bandai banned the Leader (every art of it).
Charlotte Pudding: makes your opponent shuffle away their whole hand and draw 5, wiping out their plan.
Nami (Leader): wins the game when her own deck runs out, which became too fast and hard to stop.
Gecko Moria: brings back two Characters from the trash for one card.
Trafalgar Law (Leader): removes an opposing Character and plays one of yours every turn.
Reject: a cheap Event that K.O.s a Character or deals the last point of damage, and draws you a card.

pairs.why: Borsalino could refill Life as fast as Re-Quasar used it, so the game stalled.
Luffy Leader with Katakuri untapped Characters and ramped DON!! every turn.
Luffy Leader with Big Mom gained Life while burying the opponent's Characters.

rotation.note: Block 1 (OP-01 to OP-04 and starter decks 1 to 10) left Standard on April 1, 2026. A few of those cards were reprinted with a newer block icon, and then every copy is legal again. Check the small number in the bottom corner of the card. Block 2 (OP-05 to OP-08) leaves in April 2027.
